subject: Engineering Skills
question: Which combination of foundational skills is particularly useful for an AI & Data Science engineering career?
options: Linear algebra, probability, Python programming, and data structures
Hand drafting only, with no programming or statistics
High-voltage transformer winding without data handling
Memorizing assembly opcodes without probability theory

explanation.why: AI relies on vectors/matrices (linear algebra), uncertainty modeling (probability), Python ecosystems, and clean algorithmic data pipelines.
explanation.commonTrap: Coding alone isn't enough for strong ML engineering—math intuition matters.

subject: Engineering Skills
question: Why do software and robotics teams use Git and version control systems on engineering projects?
options: To track code history, collaborate across branches safely, and roll back bugs cleanly
To physically increase CPU clock speed above factory limits
To replace all automated software testing with manual printing
To prevent more than one engineer from ever reading the codebase

explanation.why: Git records every change, enables parallel feature branches and code reviews, and lets teams revert regressions quickly.
explanation.shortcut: Git = history tracking + safe team collaboration + rollback.
explanation.commonTrap: Git manages source versions; it does not boost hardware clock speed.

subject: Engineering Skills
question: True or False: Technical writing, teamwork, and clear presentation are essential engineering skills alongside math and coding.
options: True — real engineering projects require documenting designs and collaborating across teams
False — engineers work completely alone and never write design documents

explanation.why: Modern engineering systems are built by teams; clear specifications, safety documentation, and reviews prevent costly design errors.
explanation.shortcut: Great engineers explain complex ideas clearly and collaborate well.
explanation.commonTrap: Technical brilliance still needs clear team communication to ship safely.
